derivation: from H5971 (עַם) and H5068 (נָדַב); people of liberality;
def: Amminadab, the name of four Israelites

occurrences.text: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,
And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
